cohort: Women with PPH (>1,000 mL for vaginal or cesarean delivery)
finding: The implementation of qBL led to increased rates of PPH diagnosis but did not outperform EBL in predicting the need for blood transfusion.
mod_finding: Postpartum transfusion was predicted by an EBL of 1,450 mL with AUC 0.826 and qBL 1,519 mL with AUC 0.764, for all modes of delivery.
